player_line: Rei, fancy a friendly spar? Nice and easy—let’s keep each other sharp.
dialogue: Sure, Garrett. Light contact, and either of us can call a stop. I’d like to keep that friendly part.

player_line: Rei, would you be willing to teach me Judo? I'd like to sharpen my technique.
dialogue: Sure. I can give you thirty minutes on Judo. Let’s start with your stance and balance, then see what needs adjusting. No throws on hard ground.

player_line: Rei, are you up for a fight?
dialogue: All right. A fight, then. Keep clear of the people walking through.
